name: Beijing LeiKe Defense Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing LeiKe Defense Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells radar systems, satellite applications, intelligent control, secure storage, and intelligent connected products. The company offers radar systems, which includes remote sensing radar, area surveillance radar, safety monitoring radar, car radar, signa processing and radar simulation and verification series; intelligent control; satellite application, such as beidou chips, and satellite navigation module, special and civil satellite navigation terminal; solution; satellite navigation simulator, secure storage; and radar simulation tester series and navigation simulator series.
